evidence.basis: This translation unit includes ggml_bridge_mmq.cuh and explicitly instantiates the Q4_K bridge matrix implementation. sources.cmake places the child-CTA definition on this translation unit, so the launch_matrix child branch is compiled on the actual Q4_K bridge path.

The selection retains logical I/J, block count, and fixup plan. The child path is reached only after the non-stream-K early-return branch, and requires Q4_K/J128, CC 860, and logical I128. It launches two physical y children for each unchanged stream-K x block. FP32 routes preserve the original fixup launch/reducer; BF16 routes reject fixup and instantiate the same store/accumulate/GateProduct kernel flags.

For the child specialization, logical_I remains 128 while local I is 64. Children write disjoint global logical rows. Scratch uses the original blockIdx.x, J*logical_I, and logical row indexing. Direct output adds the child base row once; local output and gate indices retain the existing column stride. Store applies GateProduct before optional BF16 residual accumulation, preserving the baseline expression order.

The public bridge regression covers rows 17408 and 384 at T1280/1281, compares full FP32 eager and captured-graph outputs bitwise, uses an independent Q4_K/Q8_1 represented-operation oracle on selected coordinates, and checks BF16 rounding, residual accumulation, and GateProduct outputs when the plan supports those routes.
Registers the public child-CTA test target and dedicated regression argument.
The experimental option remains default OFF and is restricted to CUDA architecture 86.

limits: No build, test, GPU, sanitizer, SASS, or performance run was performed.
Static review does not establish runtime parity, stream-capture success, resource use, or speedup; all manifest gates remain required.
This is an isolated prototype review, not integration approval.
